e-4447.knowledge_point: Calculating a Minor in a NxN Matrix
e-4447.problem:
What is the minor of $a_{13}$ in 
$[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 2 & 3 \\ 5 & 1 & 2 & 0 \\ 1 & 6 & 0 & -1 \\ -6 & 3 & 1 & 0\end{aligned}]$
e-4447.worked_solution:
To get the minor of $a_{13}$, we remove the $1$st row and $3$rd column:

$$
[\begin{aligned}∗ & ∗ & 2 & ∗ \\ 5 & 1 & ∗ & 0 \\ 1 & 6 & ∗ & -1 \\ -6 & 3 & ∗ & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
|\begin{aligned}5 & 1 & 0 \\ 1 & 6 & -1 \\ -6 & 3 & 0\end{aligned}|
$$

e-4448.knowledge_point: Calculating a Cofactor in a NxN Matrix
e-4448.worked_solution:
First, to get the minor of $d_{23}$, we remove the $2$nd row and $3$rd column:

$$
[\begin{aligned}0 & 2 & ∗ & -6 \\ ∗ & ∗ & -2 & ∗ \\ 6 & 0 & ∗ & 9 \\ 5 & 4 & ∗ & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
\begin{aligned}0 & 2 & -6 \\ 6 & 0 & 9 \\ 5 & 4 & 0\end{aligned}
$$

Now, the cofactor of $d_{23}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{C}_{23} & =(-1)^{2+3}{M}_{23} \\  & =-{M}_{23} \\  & =-|\begin{aligned}0 & 2 & -6 \\ 6 & 0 & 9 \\ 5 & 4 & 0\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$

decision.explanation: The minor of f₁₃ is obtained by deleting row 1 and column 3 of F. The remaining rows are (0,7,0,3), (1,2,4,-1), (5,-5,1,0), and (-1,4,11,2), matching option d.

after.name: Question 1
after.worked_solution:
To get the minor of ${f}_{13}$, we remove the $1$st row and $3$rd column:

$$
F=[\begin{aligned}∗ & ∗ & 5 & ∗ & ∗ \\ 0 & 7 & ∗ & 0 & 3 \\ 1 & 2 & ∗ & 4 & -1 \\ 5 & -5 & ∗ & 1 & 0 \\ -1 & 4 & ∗ & 11 & 2\end{aligned}]
$$

   

So, the minor is

$$
{M}_{13}=|\begin{aligned}0 & 7 & 0 & 3 \\ 1 & 2 & 4 & -1 \\ 5 & -5 & 1 & 0 \\ -1 & 4 & 11 & 2\end{aligned}|.
$$

Question 1
?

What is the minor of f13 in F=[0−15−22072031284−15−5210−143112]?

a
|7203284−1−521043112|
b
|0−152124−15−510−14112|
c
|−15−227203−521043112|
d
|0703124−15−510−14112|
e
|0203184−15210−13112|
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

To get the minor of f13, we remove the 1st row and 3rd column: F=[∗∗5∗∗07∗0312∗4−15−5∗10−14∗112]

So, the minor is

M13=|0703124−15−510−14112|.

verification.explanation: Deleting row 1 and column 3 gives the determinant displayed in option d. The revealed worked solution confirms this; the incorrect feedback refers to the deliberately submitted option c.

content.knowledge_point: Calculating a Minor in a NxN Matrix
content.worked_solution:
To get the minor of ${f}_{13}$, we remove the $1$st row and $3$rd column:

$$
F=[\begin{aligned}∗ & ∗ & 5 & ∗ & ∗ \\ 0 & 7 & ∗ & 0 & 3 \\ 1 & 2 & ∗ & 4 & -1 \\ 5 & -5 & ∗ & 1 & 0 \\ -1 & 4 & ∗ & 11 & 2\end{aligned}]
$$

   

So, the minor is

$$
{M}_{13}=|\begin{aligned}0 & 7 & 0 & 3 \\ 1 & 2 & 4 & -1 \\ 5 & -5 & 1 & 0 \\ -1 & 4 & 11 & 2\end{aligned}|.
$$

after.problem:
What is the minor of ${x}_{33}$ in 
$X=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 0 & 1 & 0 \\ -1 & 3 & 1 & 3 \\ 2 & 1 & -1 & 5 \\ 1 & 4 & 1 & -2\end{aligned}]?$
after.worked_solution:
To get the minor of ${x}_{33}$, we remove the $3$rd row and $3$rd column:

$$
X=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 0 & ∗ & 0 \\ -1 & 3 & ∗ & 3 \\ ∗ & ∗ & -1 & ∗ \\ 1 & 4 & ∗ & -2\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{33}=|\begin{aligned}-2 & 0 & 0 \\ -1 & 3 & 3 \\ 1 & 4 & -2\end{aligned}|.
$$

What is the minor of x33 in X=[−2010−131321−15141−2]?

a
|01031341−2|
b
|3131−1541−2|

|−2102−1511−2|

|−200−13314−2|

Correct
EXPLANATION

To get the minor of x33, we remove the 3rd row and 3rd column:

X=[−20∗0−13∗3∗∗−1∗14∗−2]

So, the minor is

M33=|−200−13314−2|.

content.knowledge_point: Calculating a Minor in a NxN Matrix
content.problem:
What is the minor of ${x}_{33}$ in 
$X=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 0 & 1 & 0 \\ -1 & 3 & 1 & 3 \\ 2 & 1 & -1 & 5 \\ 1 & 4 & 1 & -2\end{aligned}]?$
content.worked_solution:
To get the minor of ${x}_{33}$, we remove the $3$rd row and $3$rd column:

$$
X=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 0 & ∗ & 0 \\ -1 & 3 & ∗ & 3 \\ ∗ & ∗ & -1 & ∗ \\ 1 & 4 & ∗ & -2\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{33}=|\begin{aligned}-2 & 0 & 0 \\ -1 & 3 & 3 \\ 1 & 4 & -2\end{aligned}|.
$$

content.worked_solution:
To get the minor of of ${c}_{11}$, we remove the $1$st row and $1$st column:

$$
C=[\begin{aligned}3 & ∗ & ∗ & ∗ \\ ∗ & 7 & 0 & 1 \\ ∗ & 13 & 5 & 5 \\ ∗ & -9 & 2 & -2\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{11}=|\begin{aligned}7 & 0 & 1 \\ 13 & 5 & 5 \\ -9 & 2 & -2\end{aligned}|.
$$

a

content.knowledge_point: Calculating a Minor in a NxN Matrix
content.problem:
What is the minor of ${x}_{12}$ in 
$X=[\begin{aligned}5 & 0 & 1 & -2 \\ 3 & 3 & 11 & 7 \\ \sqrt{2} & 1 & -8 & 8 \\ -6 & 4 & 1 & -2\end{aligned}]?$
content.worked_solution:
To get the minor of ${x}_{12}$, we remove the $1$st row and $2$nd column:

$$
X=[\begin{aligned}∗ & 0 & ∗ & ∗ \\ 3 & ∗ & 11 & 7 \\ \sqrt{2} & ∗ & -8 & 8 \\ -6 & ∗ & 1 & -2\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{12}=|\begin{aligned}3 & 11 & 7 \\ \sqrt{2} & -8 & 8 \\ -6 & 1 & -2\end{aligned}|.
$$

a

b
|9101−10580|

decision.explanation: Delete row 2 and column 3 of Q. The remaining rows are (1,2,1), (-1,1,0), and (4,5,0), matching option a.

after.name: Question 5
after.worked_solution:
To get the minor of  ${q}_{23}$, we remove the $2$nd row and $3$rd column:

$$
Q=[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & ∗ & 1 \\ ∗ & ∗ & 1 & ∗ \\ -1 & 1 & ∗ & 0 \\ 4 & 5 & ∗ & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{23}=|\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 1 \\ -1 & 1 & 0 \\ 4 & 5 & 0\end{aligned}|.
$$

content.worked_solution:
To get the minor of  ${q}_{23}$, we remove the $2$nd row and $3$rd column:

$$
Q=[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & ∗ & 1 \\ ∗ & ∗ & 1 & ∗ \\ -1 & 1 & ∗ & 0 \\ 4 & 5 & ∗ & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{23}=|\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 1 \\ -1 & 1 & 0 \\ 4 & 5 & 0\end{aligned}|.
$$

decision.explanation: Delete row 2 and column 3 to obtain the minor with rows (1,-7,3), (9,0,-1), and (3,-5,0). The cofactor is (-1)^(2+3) times this minor, so it has a negative sign and matches option b.

after.name: Question 6
after.worked_solution:
First, to get the minor of ${a}_{23}$, we remove the $2$nd row and $3$rd column: 

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}1 & -7 & ∗ & 3 \\ ∗ & ∗ & 0 & ∗ \\ 9 & 0 & ∗ & -1 \\ 3 & -5 & ∗ & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{23}=|\begin{aligned}1 & -7 & 3 \\ 9 & 0 & -1 \\ 3 & -5 & 0\end{aligned}|.
$$

Now, the cofactor of ${a}_{23}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{C}_{23} & =(-1)^{2+3}{M}_{23} \\  & =-{M}_{23} \\  & =-|\begin{aligned}1 & -7 & 3 \\ 9 & 0 & -1 \\ 3 & -5 & 0\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$

Find the cofactor of a23 in A=[1−75300029011−13−510].

a
|1−7390−13−50|

−|1−7390−13−50|

−|153002310|

Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

First, to get the minor of a23, we remove the 2nd row and 3rd column:

A=[1−7∗3∗∗0∗90∗−13−5∗0]

C23=(−1)2+3M23=−M23=−|1−7390−13−50|.

content.worked_solution:
First, to get the minor of ${a}_{23}$, we remove the $2$nd row and $3$rd column: 

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}1 & -7 & ∗ & 3 \\ ∗ & ∗ & 0 & ∗ \\ 9 & 0 & ∗ & -1 \\ 3 & -5 & ∗ & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{23}=|\begin{aligned}1 & -7 & 3 \\ 9 & 0 & -1 \\ 3 & -5 & 0\end{aligned}|.
$$

Now, the cofactor of ${a}_{23}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{C}_{23} & =(-1)^{2+3}{M}_{23} \\  & =-{M}_{23} \\  & =-|\begin{aligned}1 & -7 & 3 \\ 9 & 0 & -1 \\ 3 & -5 & 0\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$

Question 7
?

Find the cofactor of x52 in X=[1−82−5−135631−1−1−56−445383−937−90].

a
|12−5−13631−1−56−44383|
b
−|12−5−13631−1−56−44383|
c
|1−82−5−1−1−564538−937−9|
d
−|1−82−5−1−1−564538−937−9|
e
|1−82−53563−1−1−564538|
Submit

decision.explanation: Delete row 5 and column 2 to obtain the minor. Since (-1)^(5+2)=-1, the cofactor is the negative of that determinant, matching option b.

Question 7
?

Find the cofactor of x52 in X=[1−82−5−135631−1−1−56−445383−937−90].

a
|12−5−13631−1−56−44383|
b
−|12−5−13631−1−56−44383|
c
|1−82−5−1−1−564538−937−9|
d
−|1−82−5−1−1−564538−937−9|
e
|1−82−53563−1−1−564538|
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

First, to get the minor of x52, we remove the 5th row and 2nd column:

X=[1∗2−5−13∗631−1∗−56−44∗383∗3∗∗∗]

So, the minor is

M52=|12−5−13631−1−56−44383|.

Now, the cofactor of x52 is

C52=(−1)5+2M52=−M52=−|12−5−13631−1−56−44383|.

verification.explanation: Removing row 5 and column 2 gives the minor shown in option a. Multiplying by (-1)^(5+2)=-1 gives option b, as confirmed by the revealed solution. The incorrect feedback concerns the deliberately submitted option c.

after.name: Question 8
after.worked_solution:
First, to get the minor of ${d}_{51}$, we remove the $5$th row and $1$st column: 

$$
D=[\begin{aligned}∗ & -8 & 2 & 0 & 1 \\ ∗ & 5 & 0 & 7 & 1 \\ ∗ & 0 & -5 & 6 & -4 \\ ∗ & 0 & 6 & 8 & 3 \\ 11 & ∗ & ∗ & ∗ & ∗\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{51}=|\begin{aligned}-8 & 2 & 0 & 1 \\ 5 & 0 & 7 & 1 \\ 0 & -5 & 6 & -4 \\ 0 & 6 & 8 & 3\end{aligned}|.
$$

Now, the cofactor of ${d}_{51}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{C}_{51} & =(-1)^{5+1}{M}_{51} \\  & ={M}_{51} \\  & =|\begin{aligned}-8 & 2 & 0 & 1 \\ 5 & 0 & 7 & 1 \\ 0 & -5 & 6 & -4 \\ 0 & 6 & 8 & 3\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$

Question 8

Find the cofactor of d51 in D=[−5−820135071−10−56−4406831130−93].

a
−|−820150710−56−40683|
b
−|3507−10−5640681130−9|
c
|−5−8203507−10−564068|
d
|−820150710−56−40683|
e
|3507−10−5640681130−9|
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

First, to get the minor of d51, we remove the 5th row and 1st column:

D=[∗−8201∗5071∗0−56−4∗068311∗∗∗∗]

So, the minor is

M51=|−820150710−56−40683|.

Now, the cofactor of d51 is

C51=(−1)5+1M51=M51=|−820150710−56−40683|.

content.knowledge_point: Calculating a Cofactor in a NxN Matrix
content.worked_solution:
First, to get the minor of ${d}_{51}$, we remove the $5$th row and $1$st column: 

$$
D=[\begin{aligned}∗ & -8 & 2 & 0 & 1 \\ ∗ & 5 & 0 & 7 & 1 \\ ∗ & 0 & -5 & 6 & -4 \\ ∗ & 0 & 6 & 8 & 3 \\ 11 & ∗ & ∗ & ∗ & ∗\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{51}=|\begin{aligned}-8 & 2 & 0 & 1 \\ 5 & 0 & 7 & 1 \\ 0 & -5 & 6 & -4 \\ 0 & 6 & 8 & 3\end{aligned}|.
$$

Now, the cofactor of ${d}_{51}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{C}_{51} & =(-1)^{5+1}{M}_{51} \\  & ={M}_{51} \\  & =|\begin{aligned}-8 & 2 & 0 & 1 \\ 5 & 0 & 7 & 1 \\ 0 & -5 & 6 & -4 \\ 0 & 6 & 8 & 3\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$

decision.explanation: Delete row 3 and column 2 to obtain rows (-1,4,0), (2,0,7), and (-4,0,1). Since (-1)^(3+2)=-1, negate this determinant to get the cofactor, matching option d.

after.name: Question 9
after.worked_solution:
First, to get the minor of ${b}_{32}$, we remove the $3$rd  row and $2$nd column: 

$$
B=[\begin{aligned}-1 & ∗ & 4 & 0 \\ 2 & ∗ & 0 & 7 \\ ∗ & 3 & ∗ & ∗ \\ -4 & ∗ & 0 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{32}=|\begin{aligned}-1 & 4 & 0 \\ 2 & 0 & 7 \\ -4 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}|.
$$

Therefore, the cofactor of ${b}_{32}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{C}_{32} & =(-1)^{3+2}{M}_{32} \\  & =-{M}_{32} \\  & =-|\begin{aligned}-1 & 4 & 0 \\ 2 & 0 & 7 \\ -4 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$

Find the cofactor of b32 in B=[−16402507035−9−4001].

a
|−16003−9−401|
b
|25703−9−401|
c
−|−160257−401|
d
−|−140207−401|
e
−|640507001|
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

First, to get the minor of b32, we remove the 3rd row and 2nd column:

B=[−1∗402∗07∗3∗∗−4∗01]

So, the minor is

M32=|−140207−401|.

Therefore, the cofactor of b32 is

C32=(−1)3+2M32=−M32=−|−140207−401|.

verification.explanation: Delete row 3 and column 2, then multiply the remaining determinant by (-1)^(3+2)=-1. This gives option d, confirmed by the revealed solution. The incorrect feedback refers to the deliberately submitted option c.

content.worked_solution:
First, to get the minor of ${b}_{32}$, we remove the $3$rd  row and $2$nd column: 

$$
B=[\begin{aligned}-1 & ∗ & 4 & 0 \\ 2 & ∗ & 0 & 7 \\ ∗ & 3 & ∗ & ∗ \\ -4 & ∗ & 0 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{32}=|\begin{aligned}-1 & 4 & 0 \\ 2 & 0 & 7 \\ -4 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}|.
$$

Therefore, the cofactor of ${b}_{32}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{C}_{32} & =(-1)^{3+2}{M}_{32} \\  & =-{M}_{32} \\  & =-|\begin{aligned}-1 & 4 & 0 \\ 2 & 0 & 7 \\ -4 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$

decision.explanation: Delete row 1 and column 5. Since (-1)^(1+5)=1, the cofactor equals the remaining determinant with a positive sign, matching option d.

after.name: Question 10
after.worked_solution:
First, to get the minor of ${d}_{15}$, we remove the $1$st row and $5$th column: 

$$
D=[\begin{aligned}∗ & ∗ & ∗ & ∗ & 2 \\ 0 & 8 & -2 & 0 & ∗ \\ 6 & 2 & -9 & 4 & ∗ \\ 1 & 5 & 2 & 1 & ∗ \\ -1 & 4 & 3 & 10 & ∗\end{aligned}]
$$

 
So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{15}=|\begin{aligned}0 & 8 & -2 & 0 \\ 6 & 2 & -9 & 4 \\ 1 & 5 & 2 & 1 \\ -1 & 4 & 3 & 10\end{aligned}|.
$$

Therefore, the cofactor of ${d}_{15}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{C}_{15} & =(-1)^{1+5}{M}_{15} \\  & ={M}_{15} \\  & =|\begin{aligned}0 & 8 & -2 & 0 \\ 6 & 2 & -9 & 4 \\ 1 & 5 & 2 & 1 \\ -1 & 4 & 3 & 10\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$

Question 10

Find the cofactor of d15 in D=[17−34208−20162−94−115210−143102].

a
−|08−2062−941521−14310|
b
−|08−2162−9−11520−1432|
c
|08−2162−9−11520−1432|
d
|08−2062−941521−14310|
e
|7−3428−2012−94−15210|
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

First, to get the minor of d15, we remove the 1st row and 5th column:

D=[∗∗∗∗208−20∗62−94∗1521∗−14310∗] So, the minor is M15=|08−2062−941521−14310|. Therefore, the cofactor of d15 is C15=(−1)1+5M15=M15=|08−2062−941521−14310|.

content.knowledge_point: Calculating a Cofactor in a NxN Matrix
content.worked_solution:
First, to get the minor of ${d}_{15}$, we remove the $1$st row and $5$th column: 

$$
D=[\begin{aligned}∗ & ∗ & ∗ & ∗ & 2 \\ 0 & 8 & -2 & 0 & ∗ \\ 6 & 2 & -9 & 4 & ∗ \\ 1 & 5 & 2 & 1 & ∗ \\ -1 & 4 & 3 & 10 & ∗\end{aligned}]
$$

 
So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{15}=|\begin{aligned}0 & 8 & -2 & 0 \\ 6 & 2 & -9 & 4 \\ 1 & 5 & 2 & 1 \\ -1 & 4 & 3 & 10\end{aligned}|.
$$

Therefore, the cofactor of ${d}_{15}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{C}_{15} & =(-1)^{1+5}{M}_{15} \\  & ={M}_{15} \\  & =|\begin{aligned}0 & 8 & -2 & 0 \\ 6 & 2 & -9 & 4 \\ 1 & 5 & 2 & 1 \\ -1 & 4 & 3 & 10\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$

decision.explanation: Expand along the first row, then along the first row of the remaining 3×3 matrix: det(Z)=(1/2)(-2)(-1)(5·8-2·2)=(1/2)·2·36=36. Thus option a is correct.

after.name: Question 11
after.problem:
Calculate the determinant of the matrix
$Z=[\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{2} & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 5 & 0 & -2 & 0 \\ 1 & 5 & 3 & 2 \\ 1 & 2 & 3 & 8\end{aligned}]$
after.worked_solution:
We use the cofactor expansion along the first row:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(Z) & ={z}_{11}{C}_{11}+{z}_{12}{C}_{12}+{z}_{13}{C}_{13}+{z}_{14}{C}_{14} \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot {C}_{11}+0\cdot {C}_{12}+0\cdot {C}_{13}+0\cdot {C}_{14} \\  & =\frac{1}{2}{C}_{11} \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot |\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{2} & ∗ & ∗ & ∗ \\ ∗ & 0 & -2 & 0 \\ ∗ & 5 & 3 & 2 \\ ∗ & 2 & 3 & 8\end{aligned}| \\  & =\frac{1}{2}(-1)^{1+1}|\begin{aligned}0 & -2 & 0 \\ 5 & 3 & 2 \\ 2 & 3 & 8\end{aligned}| \\  & =\frac{1}{2}(0\cdot |\begin{aligned}3 & 2 \\ 3 & 8\end{aligned}|-(-2)\cdot |\begin{aligned}5 & 2 \\ 2 & 8\end{aligned}|+0\cdot |\begin{aligned}5 & 3 \\ 2 & 3\end{aligned}|) \\  & =\frac{1}{2}(0+2(5\cdot 8-2\cdot 2)+0) \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot 72 \\  & =36\end{aligned}
$$

decision.explanation: Expand along row 1: det(S)=-2 times the determinant with rows (1,0,0), (1,-5,4), and (4,2,2). Expanding that determinant along its first row gives (-5)(2)-4(2)=-18. Thus det(S)=(-2)(-18)=36, matching option e.

after.name: Question 12
after.problem:
Calculate the determinant of the matrix
$S=[\begin{aligned}0 & 2 & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & 2 & -5 & 4 \\ 4 & 0 & 2 & 2\end{aligned}].$
after.worked_solution:
We use the cofactor expansion along the first row:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(S) & ={s}_{11}{C}_{11}+{s}_{12}{C}_{12}+{s}_{13}{C}_{13}+{s}_{14}{C}_{14} \\  & =0\cdot {C}_{11}+2\cdot {C}_{12}+0\cdot {C}_{13}+0\cdot {C}_{14} \\  & =2{C}_{12} \\  & =2\cdot |\begin{aligned}∗ & 2 & ∗ & ∗ \\ 1 & ∗ & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & ∗ & -5 & 4 \\ 4 & ∗ & 2 & 2\end{aligned}| \\  & =2(-1)^{1+2}|\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & -5 & 4 \\ 4 & 2 & 2\end{aligned}| \\  & =-2(1\cdot |\begin{aligned}-5 & 4 \\ 2 & 2\end{aligned}|-0\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & 4 \\ 4 & 2\end{aligned}|+0\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & -5 \\ 4 & 2\end{aligned}|) \\  & =-2((-5\cdot 2-4\cdot 2)-0+0) \\  & =-2\cdot (-18) \\  & =36\end{aligned}
$$

content.problem:
Calculate the determinant of the matrix
$A=[\begin{aligned}-3 & 0 & 0 & 5 \\ 0 & 0 & 3 & -2 \\ 4 & -1 & 2 & -3 \\ -1 & 6 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}].$
content.worked_solution:
We use the cofactor expansion along the first row:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(A) & ={a}_{11}{C}_{11}+{a}_{12}{C}_{12}+{a}_{13}{C}_{13}+{a}_{14}{C}_{14} \\  & =(-3)\cdot {C}_{11}+0\cdot {C}_{12}+0\cdot {C}_{13}+5\cdot {C}_{14} \\  & =-3{C}_{11}+5{C}_{14} \\  & =(-3)\cdot |\begin{aligned}-3 & ∗ & ∗ & ∗ \\ ∗ & 0 & 3 & -2 \\ ∗ & -1 & 2 & -3 \\ ∗ & 6 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}|+5\cdot |\begin{aligned}∗ & ∗ & ∗ & 5 \\ 0 & 0 & 3 & ∗ \\ 4 & -1 & 2 & ∗ \\ -1 & 6 & 0 & ∗\end{aligned}| \\  & =(-3)(-1)^{1+1}|\begin{aligned}0 & 3 & -2 \\ -1 & 2 & -3 \\ 6 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}|+5(-1)^{1+4}|\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 3 \\ 4 & -1 & 2 \\ -1 & 6 & 0\end{aligned}| \\  & =-3|\begin{aligned}0 & 3 & -2 \\ -1 & 2 & -3 \\ 6 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}|-5|\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 3 \\ 4 & -1 & 2 \\ -1 & 6 & 0\end{aligned}| \\  & =-3(0\cdot |\begin{aligned}2 & -3 \\ 0 & 0\end{aligned}|-3\cdot |\begin{aligned}-1 & -3 \\ 6 & 0\end{aligned}|-2\cdot |\begin{aligned}-1 & 2 \\ 6 & 0\end{aligned}|) \\  & -5(0\cdot |\begin{aligned}-1 & 2 \\ 6 & 0\end{aligned}|-0\cdot |\begin{aligned}4 & 2 \\ -1 & 0\end{aligned}|+3\cdot |\begin{aligned}4 & -1 \\ -1 & 6\end{aligned}|) \\  & =-3\cdot (-3\cdot (0+18)+(-2)\cdot (0-12))-5\cdot (3\cdot (24-1)) \\  & =90-345 \\  & =-255\end{aligned}
$$
